acceptanceCriteria: The release preflight appends optional resolver arguments only when their values are non-empty, so workflow_dispatch recovery with work_item_id and no contract_path reaches the resolver.
The release close barrier always records a failed receipt when prerequisite jobs are skipped or fail, but exits successfully as a reporting step and never claims successful closure.
Focused policy tests cover empty optional inputs and failure-summary behavior, and the embedded close script remains syntactically valid.
A hosted PR run passes before merge and one post-merge recovery run demonstrates the corrected preflight and close dependency behavior without moving or overwriting v0.2.91.
goal: Allow one explicit recovery run to stop at the earliest failed prerequisite, produce one structured failure report, and leave dependent acceptance unexecuted without a secondary close error.
intent: Repair the two release-recovery control-flow roots exposed by run 34696556737: optional resolver arguments must be omitted when unset, and the release failure-summary barrier must record dependency failure without becoming a second failing job.
requiredEvidenceClasses: and the single post-merge recovery run with structured close evidence.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A recovery dispatch with work_item_id and no contract_path reaches the resolver and produces a ready release_recovery selection.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: workflow_dispatch recovery omits unset optional resolver arguments
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the focused release gate policy and resolver regression tests, then verify one hosted recovery preflight.

scenarioCoverage.expected: When an upstream prerequisite is skipped or fails, release_close records state=failed and failureRoots without exiting as a second failure.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: preflight dependency failure produces one structured close report
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the embedded close-script policy regression and inspect the hosted recovery close artifact after an injected preflight failure.
